chapter: Dances and bands of his youth
title: College boys' bands and strip dances; Dick Mackey and Negro bands
summary: Subscription dances paid for bands, often made up of college or high school boys such as Dick Mackey's, who worked their way through school. He also names Negro bands like the Tuxedo and Papa Celestin's.
